scope: D2 general Session journey through actual offscreen QML input: build, mix, arrange, launch, save, close, reopen, export, independent decode
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12.0, offscreen platform, software Quick backend), docker --network none

desktop.note: Clean run; one of four other runs failed pipewire-quantum-257 with a one-frame capture slip (finding below), unrelated to the desktop tests

tracks: audio: imported mono WAV with 0-50 ms range
midi: template pattern with a rest, level 40
audio: imported stereo WAV, level 60, pan L40
midi: new pattern (two notes), pan R20

verified_behaviors: All edits made with pointer clicks and keyboard input on the production QML (typing paths, arrow keys, typed pan notation)
Two scenes launched Immediate while playing; active clips match each scene's membership
Saved, window closed, reopened in a fresh Session/QML: track IDs, kinds, sources, tempo, levels, pans, clip range, all four scene memberships and both MIDI patterns equal the authored edits
Two-bar export via the UI decoded independently: both channels within 1 LSB of per-track renders mixed with the declared levels and balance pan
finding: pipewire-quantum-257 (mono fl-live-play, unchanged by this test) once captured a one-frame slip mid-stream (values continued shifted by one frame). The dropped-cycle retry intentionally does not cover this; a similar non-dropped mismatch was seen earlier from the pw-cat reference producer, which links no fl-live code.
limits: Offscreen platform with synthetic input events, silent preview clock. Not native Wayland input, not physical audio, not a packaged release.
